{{Quote|Sergeant Vollot, is your ''bomb squad'' ready?''"<br />"''Yes, sir, Captain Treece, we'll begin energy scans immediately.|Treece and Vollot|<ref name="SW 56" />}}
'''Bomb squad stormtroopers''', commonly called '''bombtroopers''', were an elite class of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] trained in the activation and deactivation of explosive charges.

==History==
The bombtroopers were trained to disarm explosive devices varying from anti-tank mines to primitive spring traps. The bombtroopers were also considered superior to bomb-disposal droids due to their training, which was sufficient to recover an explosive device intact, which allowed for Imperial Intelligence to study it after recovery.<ref name="IHB">''[[Star Wars: Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]''</ref>

[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Hugo Treece]] dispatched a group of bombtroopers, led by [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Vollot]], to [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin's]] [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]], shortly after the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]] to scan for and disarm bombs set there by revolting [[Ugnaught/Legends|Ugnaughts]] after the Empire took over the city. A [[talking bomb]] invented by the Ugnaughts tricked the bombtroopers into killing themselves when it had them arm the explosive rather than disarm it.<ref name="SW 56" />

==Equipment==
Bombtroopers wore specially modified heavy fire-resistant armor for flame precautions. The armor was likewise strong enough to withstand controlled explosions and high-velocity shrapnel.<ref name="IHB" /> For further aid, a long hood covered the faceplate, and they all wore safety helmets. Their helmets included sensors for detecting chemical signatures of explosives, as well as a full muffling mode that is automatically enabled at the first sign of a detonation to protect the wearer from eye or ear damage.<ref name="IHB" /> They carried their tools in large round cases.

Overall, their armor strongly resembled that of the [[Cold assault stormtrooper]]s, although with a few notable differences. One of these differences is that the helmets are replaced with domed hats with a protrusion on each side, and the other was their having striped sleeves on their arms and near the torso.

==Behind the scenes==
The bombtrooper was created by [[David Michelinie]], [[Walter Simonson]], and [[Tom Palmer]]. Certain elements of the armor's design, most notably the helmets, were taken from unused concept sketches for the snowtrooper armor in [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''The Empire Strikes Back'']].
